title: Doenjang Glazed Duck Breast with Zesty Korean Carrots
description: A fusion of Korean and French flavors in this doenjang glazed duck breast recipe, served with zesty Korean carrots.

ingredients.name: Zesty Korean carrots
ingredients.notes: Glazed with doenjang and sesame oil

instructions: Season the duck breast with salt and black pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the duck breast for 2 minutes.
Transfer the duck to the oven and roast for 12-15 minutes.
While the duck is cooking, stir-fry the doenjang with sugar and vinegar in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Korean chili flakes to the doenjang glaze and stir to combine.
Glaze the duck breast with the doenjang mixture during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Meanwhile, prepare the zesty Korean carrots by glazing them with sesame oil, sugar, and vinegar in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Season the carrots with salt and black pepper to taste.
Slice the duck breast and serve with the zesty Korean carrots.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
